system.description:
Tutored by a single master rather than any institution: no lecture hall, no cohort, just a master's attention and very high expectations.

  • Rote Learning: choose one 1st-level spell in your spellbook, drilled until you could cast it asleep. It is always prepared and does not count against your prepared total. When damage makes you lose a spell you are casting, you keep its slot.
    • 9th level: also one 2nd-level and one 3rd-level spell.
  • Master's Name: Advantage on checks with your master's peers, and on identifying magic made by your master's school.
